sourceTitle: We’re providing funding for organizations building AI for teachers.
originalTitle: We’re providing funding for organizations building AI for teachers.

blocks.text: Google.org has long supported teachers and students, including free AI training for educators. Today, Google.org is providing over $9.5 million in funding across five organizations building with and for educators, aiming to help millions of students reach their full potential:
blocks.zh: Google.org长期支持师生,包括对教育工作者进行免费的人工智能培训。今天,我们...Google.org正在提供超过950万美元的资金,用于5个组织与教育工作者一起建设和为教育工作者建设,旨在帮助数百万学生充分发挥潜力:
blocks.en: Google.org has long supported teachers and students, including free AI training for educators. Today, Google.org is providing over $9.5 million in funding across five organizations building with and for educators, aiming to help millions of students reach their full potential:

blocks.text: The City University of New York: Helping educators build digital and computational literacy through the Computing Integrated Teacher Education (CITE) initiative
blocks.zh: 纽约市立大学:通过计算综合师范教育倡议,帮助教育工作者建立数字和计算知识水平
blocks.en: The City University of New York: Helping educators build digital and computational literacy through the Computing Integrated Teacher Education (CITE) initiative

blocks.text: Fab AI: Collaborating with Google DeepMind and the Gates Foundation to build open models that help teachers plan lessons and support early reading
blocks.zh: Fab AI: (法语).与Google DeepMind和Gates基金会合作,建立开放模式,帮助教师规划课程和支持早期阅读
blocks.en: Fab AI: Collaborating with Google DeepMind and the Gates Foundation to build open models that help teachers plan lessons and support early reading

blocks.text: Krause Center for Innovation: Helping school districts bring responsible AI education into classrooms
blocks.zh: 克劳兹创新中心:帮助校区将负责任的人工智能教育带入课堂
blocks.en: Krause Center for Innovation: Helping school districts bring responsible AI education into classrooms

blocks.text: Teaching Lab: Piloting Coherence OS, an operating system that gives teachers and leaders real-time support
blocks.zh: 教学实验室:试验一致性操作系统,向教师和领导人提供实时支持的操作系统;
blocks.en: Teaching Lab: Piloting Coherence OS, an operating system that gives teachers and leaders real-time support

blocks.text: 1EdTech Global: Building public infrastructure for trusted learning standards
blocks.zh: 1EdTech 全球:为可信的学习标准建设公共基础设施
blocks.en: 1EdTech Global: Building public infrastructure for trusted learning standards
